findings.claim: The integrated verdict INCONSISTENT is correct on the merits, but it is a verdict with no remediation behind it: the shipping file was frozen before the record was written and still carries the seam, unchanged across two full review rounds.
findings.evidence: Timestamps: candidates-final/las-b16-001.json = 13:25:20; reviews/integrated.jsonl = 13:33:50; no later write to the unit. Diff candidates-corrected → candidates-final touches only questions[1].rationale and generator_meta.question_families.4 — the passage is byte-identical, and diff candidates → candidates-corrected is the single word "vidgade" → "utvidgade". The seam is still present verbatim: dating gives magasin = 1879 ("Folkskolan i Sölvinge, uppförd 1904" + "murat tjugofem år tidigare"), kiln history gives "Den första ugnen var en fältugn" … "År 1884 ersattes den av en ringugn med sexton kamrar.", and the only colour mechanism in the text is chamber-position: "Var i kammaren en sten hade stått syntes på den efteråt." The same paragraph grades the pale stones "kom ut bleka och porösa och dög bara till innermurar", while the opening exhibit puts them in an outer wall: "I ytterväggen på magasinet vid Sölvinges ångbåtsbrygga sitter tegel i tre färger." … "överst går färgen över i blekgult" … "Ingenting av detta är slumpartat."
findings.why: The 1879 magasin brick was fired in a fältugn, which has no kammare and no eldkanaler, so the passage explains the colour of the very wall it opens with by a mechanism belonging to a kiln built five years later — and grades the palest band as fit only for inner walls while showing it in an yttervägg. The round-1 audit logged exactly this against a MINOR_NOTES integrated verdict; round 2 escalated to INCONSISTENT, which is the right call, but nothing was fixed. No key moves — Q2 key B remains the only textually supported answer to "Vad avgjorde, enligt texten, en stens färg?" — so the verdict is confirmed rather than refuted; but a consumer reading only reviews/integrated.jsonl would reasonably assume the INCONSISTENT finding had been dispositioned, and it was not.

findings.claim: The Q1 rationale and planted_traps misapply the taxonomy tag reversed_causality to option B; B reverses nothing, it displaces the event in time.
findings.evidence: Q1 option B: "Kalkkornen sprängde sönder stenens yta i ugnens hetta under själva bränningen." Q1 rationale: "B är reversed_causality i tidsledet och den svåraste distraktorn"; planted_traps.1.B: "reversed_causality (skadans tidsled inverterat)". pipeline/synthetic/las/families.md defines the tag: "reversed_causality | 295 | Right elements, wrong direction — cause/effect or subject/object swapped". In B the causal arrow is intact — the lime grain is still the cause and the spalled face still the effect; only the stage of the process moves ("i ugnens hetta under själva bränningen" vs the passage's "Kornet låg sedan kvar i det färdiga teglet och tog upp fukt ur luften, svällde och tryckte loss en flisa ur ytan."). The unit applies the same tag correctly twice elsewhere — Q3-C reverses who bears the loss, Q4-B inverts hotter-fire/less-fuel — so this is a misapplication, not a house convention.
findings.why: The rationale is the student-facing teaching payload. Telling a student that B is a reversed-causality trap trains the wrong detector — look for a flipped arrow — when the lesson B actually carries is "right mechanism, wrong stage of the process". Sibling units coin a new tag when the taxonomy has no fit (las-b16-002 "unsupported_causality"; las-b16-003 "reversed_direction", "role_or_attribution_swap"), so bank precedent is to name the trap accurately rather than stretch a defined tag with a qualifier.

findings.claim: The Q4 rationale labels distractor D an overgeneralisation and never names the property a G-STEM gate already recorded in writing — that D does not answer the stem at all.
findings.evidence: Q4 stem: "Vad förklarar, enligt texten, att vedåtgången per tusen stenar sjönk efter 1884?" Option D: "Skärmtaken tycks ha blivit överflödiga sedan rökgaserna kunde torka godset." Q4 rationale: "D är overgeneralisation i gardad form"; planted_traps.4.D: "overgeneralisation (gardad)". report.json, gate G-STEM, target q:4: "D additionally fails stem-fit because awnings becoming superfluous does not explain wood consumption." families.md defines overgeneralisation by absolutisers ("alla / alltid / aldrig / bara / enbart") — D carries none and is explicitly hedged ("tycks ha") — and it carries a dedicated tag for what D actually is: "true_but_irrelevant | 57 | True in itself but doesn't answer the stem." The unit uses overgeneralisation correctly at Q3-B, whose option does carry an absolutiser ("kom inga klagomål").
findings.why: D is a legitimate distractor — true_but_irrelevant is an authentic corpus trap with 57 instances — so this does not make Q4 non-functional and does not flip MINOR_FIXES. But the pedagogy stage's only applied change to this unit was a rewrite of the Q2 A-clause rationale; the G-STEM stem-fit note went undispositioned in both the rationale and the review record, and the label the student is handed points at absolutisers instead of at the option's real defect.

findings.claim: Two overstatements logged by the round-1 audit survive the round-2 MINOR_FIXES edit, one of them inside the very sentence that was edited.
findings.evidence: Q2 rationale still reads "men texten stänger vägen: leran från de båda gravarna blandades på slagbordet, och efter 1875 brändes inget tegel av enbart den ena sorten" — the passage's own "efter 1875" concedes single-source brick for 1868–1875, and the works ran "mellan 1868 och 1913". generator_meta.self_blind_solve still reads "samtliga nycklar hänger på uppdiktade partikulariteter", although Q4's key A ("Luften förvärmdes av svalnande stenar och rökgaserna torkade nästa gods.") is textbook Hoffmann ring-kiln recuperation that report.json's G-STEM flag records as pickable passage-blind: "WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind_pick A)". A third, smaller instance is new: the Q1 rationale converts a hedge into an exclusion — passage "I ugnen hände detta sällan." vs rationale "texten uttryckligen säger att detta sällan hände i ugnen utan när stenen stått en tid i stapeln eller redan var inmurad".
findings.why: The round-2 pedagogy pass did edit questions[1].rationale — it expanded the A-clause about the lexical echo on kalken — so the stage had that sentence open and left the flagged D-clause overstatement verbatim. None of these makes a claim that is false about the world or about a post-1875 stone, and no key moves, so MINOR_FIXES stands; but the record shows fixes landing adjacent to, rather than on, the logged defects.
